items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: So we got together and organized the Jazz Festivals Society of Philadelphia... Al Rose, who was a disc jockey.

ctx.x: The Jazz Festival Society of Philadelphia was...a guy named Al Rose had the idea to have some sessions and they approached me. Miss Bowman and a lawyer and Al approached me. They said, 'Well, we're interested in the thing. But we can't be interested in the thing to underwrite...' because I felt like in order for it to be a success you'd have to have these sessions every week. So we got together and organized the Jazz Festivals Society of Philadelphia, Sammy Price Director, Jane Bowman, who worked for... ....NWAS,…

And then...I had bought a club with a couple of guys, an after hours spot. Well, it was a club, you know, drinking and that business. In Philadelphia on Sunday you couldn't buy whiskey.
